resolves_prior_failure_record.resolved_note: V3-EXQ-945 (2026-08-25, diagnostic PASS, adjudicated by this autopsy) meets both structural clauses of the target UNDER A PRE-REGISTERED LEVER SUBSTITUTION that governance must ratify explicitly: the record's own metric line defines 'the documented operating weight' as wanting_weight=0.5, a lever no 945 arm touches -- 945 substituted the mode_value term (pre-registered in the driver docstring, queue note and design doc: a fresh ResidueField's valence head is identically zero in the V3-EXQ-869/923 wash-out regime, and the min-spread-floor guard correctly refuses to amplify a flat term), and the record's addressed_by schema contemplates 'a later build/lever'. Under that substituted lever: (a) ARM_AUTH_RANGE selection_flip_rate > 0 on 5/5 seeds at operating gain 0.5 with cem_modulatory_authority_competitive_frac = 1.0; (b) ARM_AUTH_THROUGHPUT abs(mean_resource_proximity gap vs ablation) > 1e-4 on 3/5 seeds (0.6 == the pre-registered floor) in an arm whose elite argmin demonstrably flips (flip rates 0.067-0.360). CAVEATS the flip does NOT erase: because mode_value is 19-137x dominant over terrain, the rescale ran ATTENUATE-ONLY (scale ~0.004-0.026 on every scored tick) -- the amplify-up regime V3-EXQ-931's failure actually exercised (weak lever, scale ~135) was tested by zero cells and remains undemonstrated; throughput is marginal (2/5 seeds behaviourally bit-identical to ablation -- the 931 null signature persists there); the gap is direction-agnostic and the non-gating harm readout regressed (+0.065 more harm under routing). The behavioural falsifier the design doc gates on this PASS remains unqueued.

learning_extracted: The elite-stage authority rescale at gain 0.5 acts as a NORMALISER, not an amplifier: the raw mode_value spread is 19-137x the terrain spread, so the unscaled sum flips the terrain argmin on ~93% of ticks (ARM_OFF), and authority-ON arms flip on only ~30% -- the rescale bounds a naturally-dominant modulatory term to 0.5x terrain spread. A competitive-ratio reading on an ON arm must always be read against the OFF-arm raw ratio, which this driver records for exactly that purpose.

The elite stage is confirmed advisory-only without routing: ARM_OFF, ARM_AUTH_RANGE and ARM_AUTH_STD are behaviourally bit-identical per seed on all 5 seeds; only the cem_elite route reaches committed behaviour, and on 2/5 seeds even a flipped elite argmin produces zero behavioural difference.

Driver instrument defect (cosmetic for this run's criteria, must be fixed in any successor): cem_modulatory_throughput_available is a hippocampal propose-diagnostics key, not an e3_selector.last_score_diagnostics key; the driver's e3-side read returns None every tick and the reported frac is 0.0 by construction. The route-range read (modulatory_channel_route_range) is the live e3-side field and behaved as expected.

The dry-run denominator quirk (seed fractions denominated over len(SEEDS)=5 even when dry-run truncates to 2 seeds) makes the queue note's '--dry-run PASS' claim impossible for C_AUTH/C_THROUGHPUT as coded -- the smoke can only have passed a weaker path. Not evidence-bearing here (real run scored), but worth knowing when reading 945-family smoke claims.

The routed throughput currently DEGRADES the non-gating harm readout (+0.065 arm-mean harm rate vs ablation) and the proximity gap is direction-mixed (-0.040/+0.090/+0.062). The failure_record target only demanded a nonzero gap, so the PASS stands, but the behavioural falsifier (design doc Section 8's gated next step, both gates now met) is where direction gets adjudicated.

Red-team (7c) contest D1, disposed at the gate: the failure_record's metric line names wanting_weight=0.5 as 'the documented operating weight'; 945's pre-registered mode_value substitution means the target is met under a different lever, and the rescale ran attenuate-only (scale = gain*terr_spread/mod_spread ~ 0.004-0.026 every scored tick, recomputable from the manifest) -- the amplify-up regime 931's failure exercised was run by zero cells. The resolved_note above states the substitution and the untested regime explicitly; whether to flip resolved on that basis, or hold the record open pending a wanting-lever (amplify-up) demonstration once residue accumulates, is the governance choice this artifact surfaces.
